summary.zh-CN: 把会议纪要或转写整理成有出处的决定、负责人与待办草案，对外写入须逐条确认。
summary.en: Turns meeting notes or transcripts into cited decisions, owners and proposed tasks; every external write needs your confirmation.

modifications.zh-CN: frontmatter 只保留 name 与 description，去掉 Hermes 专属字段。
modifications.en: Frontmatter keeps only name and description; Hermes-specific fields removed.

modifications.zh-CN: read_file、teams-meeting-pipeline 与专用工单连接器改为「用户提供的资料」「本会话已授权的工具」；对外写入逐条经本人确认。
modifications.en: read_file, teams-meeting-pipeline and dedicated tracker connectors were replaced with user-provided materials and tools already authorized in the conversation; each external write needs confirmation.

modifications.zh-CN: 仓库根 LICENSE（MIT，Nous Research 版权声明）随资源文件收录。
modifications.en: The repository root LICENSE (MIT, Nous Research copyright notice) is included with the resource files.

conditions.zh-CN: 写入任务或外部工单需要对应工具已授权。
conditions.en: Writing tasks or external tickets needs the corresponding tools to be authorized.
